capabilities: Sync contacts from the macOS Contacts app into notes
Filter which contacts sync using Contacts app Smart Lists
Create contact notes from a configurable template with data tags
Preserve custom note content across syncs using a keep delimiter
extras: Syncing overwrites existing contact notes; upgrading from versions below 2.0.0 requires backing up old contact notes. The plugin runs an AppleScript and needs permission for Obsidian to access Contacts; 'Export photos in vcard' must be disabled in the Contacts app.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring contact data from the Mac's Contacts app into vault notes.
summary: Contact sync tool that pulls contacts from the macOS Contacts app into Obsidian notes via a command.
